# Yoldash

> Yoldash (یولداش) is a web platform connecting shippers, drivers and transport companies, focused on road freight between Türkiye and Iran. Its official domain is getyoldash.com.

## Public product information
- [Official website](https://www.getyoldash.com/): Web application.
- [About Yoldash — English](https://www.getyoldash.com/en/about): Identity, audience, services and scope.
- [درباره یولداش](https://www.getyoldash.com/fa/about): Persian product information.
- [Yoldash hakkında](https://www.getyoldash.com/tr/hakkimizda): Turkish product information.

## Current public workflows
Browse published loads and filter by origin, destination, vehicle type and truck count. Sort listed freight amounts within a selected currency. Distance sorting uses straight-line distance to a load origin after the visitor grants location access. Load posting and account conversations require signing in and the relevant feature access.

Yoldash is a coordination platform. Load data is supplied by users; commercial terms and operational suitability require confirmation with the transport counterpart. These pages do not establish carrier licensing, insurance cover, an official transport quote or guaranteed shipment availability.
